curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8208-1-1.pdf (the frame is steps 1-12, the front fork its own steps 1-9, joined in step 13)

functions.does: The handlebars steer the front wheel: the long front fork hangs from the head of the frame on a single black friction pin, steeply raked along the fork legs, so the whole fork, handlebars and front wheel swing round it together (stiffly, as the pin is a friction pin).
functions.source: book: fork steps 1-6 (the pin goes in the fork's grey cross block in step 5), frame step 6 (the grey cross block it plugs into) and step 13; inferred: the book draws no steering arrow, and the fork has no other joint to the frame

functions.does: Both wheels roll freely: the front one on an axle between the fork's two toggle joints, the rear one on an axle at the back of the frame; nothing is driven, and the cams of the engine are fixed.
functions.source: book: frame step 10 (rear wheel), fork step 9 (front wheel)
